revit.units_note: Revit's internal length is decimal feet; the project's display units are the user's. Apply georeference.origin VERBATIM as the survey point / shared coordinates and set its Elev to 0 — every artifact's Z is ABSOLUTE orthometric height, not an offset from the origin. Grid rotation is zero by construction: the emitters reproject per-vertex, so meridian convergence is already absorbed. Do not re-derive any of this; origin.projected.linear_unit describes the ORIGIN's coordinates and each artifact's own `units` describes that file (they differ on the local_ft tier, where the origin is metric UTM and the files are international feet).
